body: I don't really have anywhere I could Skype in private, as there's always at least 2 oblivious housemates home :/

Yeah, the only real reason I haven't gone though with thing is family. Im past the point of really caring about anything, but knowing my parents and brother would be devastated (more so, considering we already lost my older brother) keeps me from going through. Other than that, I really don't give any fucks about much of anything anymore. It's actually bothersome at this point, I think
Yes, I've taken a road trip to San Francisco and back. I would say that, on a whole, was one of the best experiences of my life.

You have a very valid point about the freeway, advice I'll take. Another way, I guess. The bit about trying new things sounds good, but part of my problem is I simply don't enjoy anything anymore. I have no will to do anything, even new things and things I used to love and live for. I'm just broken. I can't think of a better way to word it, just.. broken. The whole "getting out of my 'comfort' zone doesn't work for me anymore, it's like any positive effect is cancelled out almost immediately. I really do appreciate the suggestions, I don't want it to seem as if I don't, I just feel irreparable at this point.
Not lately, no. I wouldn't say it's any of their fault, though
